strategies.overview: Boasting the incredibly strong Technician Population Bomb along with the ability to set up and remove hazards in a single turn, Maushold stands out as one of the most threatening setup sweepers in the metagame. Due to its ability to outspeed and OHKO the majority of the tier after a single turn of boosting, it is imperative for every non-hyper offense team to have an answer to Maushold. Unfortunately for Maushold, this can be done incredibly easily by having any decently defensive Pokemon hold Rocky Helmet, as the multihit nature of Population Bomb simultaneously serves as its greatest strength and its Achilles' heel. Maushold's relative frailty also means that it can be easily dealt with by strong priority users and bulkier Pokemon that are able to survive a hit and KO it back.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Maushold's greatest weakness, contact effects, can be neutralized with Protective Pads, albeit at the cost of drastically decreasing Population Bomb's reliability. Loaded Dice is an alternative to Wide Lens that improves Bullet Seed's reliability while still guaranteeing at least 4 hits with Population Bomb. Tera Fire can be used to prevent Maushold from getting burned by Will-O-Wisp Talonflame and grant it free turns to set up against it.

Checks and Counters

Contact Effects: Any of the physical walls in the tier, including Hippowdon, Chesnaught, Gastrodon, and Slowbro, can eliminate Maushold with the help of Rocky Helmet, with the interaction causing Maushold to faint after hitting just 6 times from full health. Pokemon such as Static Bellibolt and Flame Body Talonflame can also be used to cripple, instead of outright KO, Maushold at a very high probability as punishment for clicking Population Bomb; although they are less reliable, they have an edge over the other physical walls, as their anti-Maushold weapon cannot be neutralized with Knock Off.

Faster Wallbreakers: Faster offensive Pokemon such as Barraskewda and Choice Scarf users such as Galarian Zapdos and Mienshao can revenge kill an unboosted Maushold, though the latter two have to be wary of a possible Tera Ghost from Maushold that could flip the game in its favor in a single turn.

Steel-type Wallbreakers: Powerful Steel-types such as Hisuian Goodra and Choice Specs Magnezone can survive a hit from Maushold and KO it back. Hisuian Goodra in particular can temporarily cripple Maushold with Gooey and therefore allow its teammates to deal with it even if Maushold has accrued several Tidy Up boosts.

Mimikyu: In the hyper offense mirror matchup, Mimikyu is one of the only Pokemon that can consistently deal with Maushold thanks to its immunity to Population Bomb. Mimikyu does, however, need to be wary of Bite that can take it out with enough flinches and Bullet Seed that can potentially KO Mimikyu past Disguise after Maushold gets one or two Attack boosts.

movesets.name: Tidy Up
movesets.description:
Set Details

Tidy Up offers incredible utility, as it allows Maushold to set up and unpreventably remove hazards in a single slot. Bite is a go-to coverage option, as it allows Maushold to hit Ghost-types like Basculegion-F and Gengar. Bullet Seed is an alternative that can similarly hit the aforementioned Ghost-types as well as Rocky Helmet Hippowdon, which is one of Maushold's most common checks, at the cost of fizzling against Gengar. Encore can provide Maushold with free turns by locking an opponent into a useless move, which can often be game-winning due to Maushold's unrivaled power. Low Kick is another coverage option that enables Maushold to deal with bulky Steel-types such as Hisuian Goodra, Registeel, and Eviolite Bisharp. Wide Lens is crucial for Maushold to improve Population Bomb's consistency, as otherwise it only has an approximate 35% chance to hit 10 times. Technician boosts all of Population Bomb, Bite, and Bullet Seed, enabling Maushold to be incredibly threatening despite its low Attack stat. Tera Ghost provides Maushold with valuable immunities to Fighting and Normal and a resistance to Bug, which can prevent it from getting revenge killed by Fighting-type attacks, including Body Press from Chesnaught and Close Combat from Choice Scarf Galarian Zapdos, as well as Entei's Extreme Speed. This can be capitalized on with Encore to give Maushold incredibly valuable free turns to set up. Tera Normal can be used instead to boost Population Bomb's power, which allows Maushold to OHKO bulky Pokemon like Wo-Chien and specially defensive Umbreon without needing to set up.

Maushold fits best on offense, particularly hyper offense, structures, primarily due its ability to remove hazards despite already being an incredibly powerful setup sweeper. Becase of this, it synergizes with other setup sweepers like Covert Cloak Gyarados and Weakness Policy Armarouge that are weak to Stealth Rock. While Maushold can be easily punished with physical walls holding Rocky Helmet such as Hippowdon, Slowbro, and Chesnaught, it can often deal massive amounts of damage to them before fainting, which can give other physically offensive setup sweepers such as Bisharp and Mimikyu the wiggle room to pull off a sweep later in the game. Maushold particularly benefits from specially offensive teammates like Armarouge and Gardevoir that can exploit any of the aforementioned physical walls hoping to get rid of Maushold. On generally offensive structures, Maushold can act as the primary setup sweeper and therefore greatly appreciates Knock Off support from Pokemon like Krookodile and Galarian Zapdos to remove Rocky Helmet from opposing physical walls.

movesets.name: Tidy Up Sweeper
movesets.description:
Tidy Up Maushold is a good setup sweeper for Normal teams, as it is able to outspeed and take out threats like non-Choice Scarf Iron Valiant, non-Iron Defense Zamazenta, and Urshifu-R. At +1 Attack, Population Bomb becomes a fierce move, taking out a plethora of threats not running Rocky Helmet, notably Toxapex and Gouging Fire. Bite allows Maushold to threaten Ghost-types like Dragapult and Hisuian Zoroark at +1, while Encore lets Maushold lock foes into moves such as locking Corviknight into Defog and Kingambit into Sucker Punch; this allows Maushold to get a potential Tidy Up turn. Low Kick can be run over Encore to hit pesky Steel- and Rock-types like Kingambit, Hisuian Goodra, Heatran, and Tyranitar. Play Rough threatens Dark- and Dragon-types like Hydreigon, Sableye on a switch in, and unboosted Roaring Moon, but running it leaves Maushold vulnerable to Kingambit. Wide Lens is the best item for Maushold to ensure Population Bomb is accurate as possible.

Hisuian Zoroark is a great teammate for Maushold, providing a Fighting immunity while also fooling its foes due to Illusion. It also takes out physically bulky Pokemon like Gholdengo and Archaludon with Shadow Ball and Focus Blast and can use Trick to lock walls like Sableye into undesirable moves by giving them Choice Specs, which eases Maushold's sweeping capabilities. Ditto reverse sweeps against potential setup sweepers like Chien-Pao and Ceruledge, while Maushold provides entry hazard removal via Tidy Up, keeping Ditto as healthy as possible. Indeedee eases the Fighting matchup by dealing with Zamazenta and Choice Specs Keldeo with Expanding Force. It also provides Healing Wish support, allowing one of its teammates a second chance to sweep, and sets up Psychic Terrain so that Maushold does not fear revenge killing attempts from the likes of Kingambit and Keldeo. Ursaluna-B is a great bulky teammate, taking out Steel- and Poison-types like Archaludon and Sneasler, which would otherwise be troublesome to Maushold. Calm Mind Terapagos with BoltBeam coverage deals with pesky Flying- and Dragon-types like Corviknight, Skarmory, and Dragonite for Maushold. Blissey is an amazing special wall, tanking special hits from Flutter Mane and Greninja while also spreading paralysis via Thunder Wave. It also provides hazard support with Stealth Rock, which gives Maushold chance to OHKO Gliscor.

strategies.comments:
Teambuilding

  • Maushold can support various teams. It is most commonly used on rain and balance teams featuring Annihilape.
  • On rain teams, Maushold uses Beat Up to assist Archaludon in gaining Defense boosts from Stamina as well as increasing the damage of Rage Fist from Annihilape. It also provides redirection, allowing Annihilape to set up further with Bulk Up and other partners such as Basculegion-M to attack safely.
  • On balance teams, Maushold provides the same support to Annihilape and additionally supports partners such as Gholdengo and Kingambit with redirection, allowing them to safely set up with Nasty Plot and Swords Dance, respectively.
  • Maushold is threatened by Fighting-types such as Sneasler. Partners such as Annihilape and Gholdengo are difficult for Sneasler to KO and can easily KO Sneasler in return. Maushold is also walled by Ghost-types like Gholdengo. Incineroar can comfortably survive attacks from Gholdengo and threaten it with Knock Off. Taunt easily disrupts Maushold, requiring Maushold to switch out to remove the effect.

Strategy Comments

  • Maushold performs best when it redirects attacks and enabling its partners to set up safely and sweep. Leading Maushold is often a great choice, allowing its partners to take early-game KOs.
  • Maushold can be used flexibly. Follow Me is vital for granting its partner a turn to safely set up or take a KO at any point during the game, and the offensive set can sometimes deal just enough damage to take a surprising KO on a big opposing threat.
  • Maushold is easily disrupted by Taunt, so it needs to Taunt the opposing support Pokemon itself or rely on its partners to take out opposing Taunt users. Offensive Maushold is additionally threatened by Rocky Helmet and Rough Skin, both of which KO it after it has used Population Bomb.

movesets.name: Offensive Support
movesets.description:
• Offensive Maushold aims to soften up foes or take surprising KOs with Technician Population Bomb while also providing redirection and disruption support.
  • Population Bomb allows Maushold to deal devastating damage, especially with ten hits, which is enough to remove threats such as Dragonite. Taunt shuts down Trick Room setters like Porygon2 and opposing support Pokemon like Amoonguss.
  • Tera Ghost makes Maushold immune to Close Combat from Sneasler, Fake Out from Incineroar, and Extreme Speed from Dragonite. Tera Grass grants Maushold an immunity to Spore and Rage Powder. Tera Grass also provides useful resistances to Water- and Electric-type attacks such as Wave Crash from Basculegion and Electro Shot from Archaludon.
  • Wide Lens is used to increase the accuracy of Population Bomb, greatly increasing the chance of landing ten hits.
  • While this set is capable of dealing high damage, it is reliant on landing enough Population Bomb hits to take out or weaken threats. This set lacks defensive investment, so it is not expected to be able to redirect attacks throughout the battle.

movesets.name: Bulky Support
movesets.description:
• As a bulky support Pokemon, Maushold aims to redirect attacks for its partners as well as disrupt its foes. Maushold additionally has Friend Guard, increasing the survivability of its allies.
  • Beat Up is used to increase the power of Rage Fist from a partner Annihilape and grant Defense boosts to a partner Archaludon with Stamina; it can also be used to break Focus Sashes. Taunt disrupts Trick Room setters and opposing support Pokemon like Porygon2 and Electabuzz.
  • Tera Ghost makes Maushold immune to Close Combat from Sneasler, Fake Out from Incineroar, and Extreme Speed from Dragonite. Tera Fairy turns Maushold's weakness to Close Combat into a resistance and provides an immunity to Outrage from Dragonite. Tera Fairy is also a great defensive typing into the metagame.
  • Safety Goggles grants Maushold an immunity to Spore and Rage Powder.
  • This Maushold set is capable of taking multiple attacks; however, it is easily disrupted by Taunt, forcing Maushold to be switched out to remove the effect. The set is also very passive and deals very low damage.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 7 onwards

Price Range: 3-5 points

Overview: Maushold stands out as a niche setup sweeper and wallbreaker with access to Tidy Up and its signature move, Population Bomb. With Technician-boosted STAB Population Bomb, solid coverage, and a good Speed stat, it can threaten to sweep teams that have been weakened enough by its teammates. Unfortunately, Maushold is often a one trick pony, relying on Population Bomb to deal a massive amount of damage, which can be predicted and exploited easily. In addition, it is very frail, which can lead it to being picked off by faster revenge killers and priority attacks. Finally, it requires opportunities to set up to deal any meaningful damage with coverage moves due to its lackluster Attack, which can slow down momentum in its favor.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Setup Sweeper: With Tidy Up, Maushold can become almost unstoppable against severely weakened teams with Population Bomb. It usually also has Bite to deal with Ghost-types, making choosing the fourth moveslot difficult, as it likes to run some sort of utility to support its team or run additional coverage against specific threats.

Wallbreaker: Even without setup, Maushold can still deal damage instantly by using Population Bomb. It can occasionally also use Choice Scarf to act as speed control or Choice Band to heavily cripple and sometimes KO a foe.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Population Bomb

Setup Moves: Tidy Up

Utility Moves: Thunder Wave, Encore, Taunt, U-turn

Coverage: Bite, Low Kick, Play Rough, Seed Bomb, Bullet Seed, Aerial Ace

Niche Moves

Super Fang: Maushold can use Super Fang against problematic Rock and Steel-types to chip them down enough for either itself or a teammate to take down later.

Switcheroo: Maushold can use Switcheroo to hinder an annoying foe that it may fail to take down by itself.

Common Items

Protective Pads: Maushold can utilize Protective Pads if it fears foes with a Rocky Helmet or contact effects.

Wide Lens: Wide Lens boosts the accuracy of Population Bomb to make it more likely that all of its attacks connect.

Niche Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Maushold can use Heavy-Duty Boots to get around entry hazards that can quickly chip it down, especially if it plans on switching in often.

Choice Band: If needed, Maushold can use a Choice Band to muscle through a foe that it otherwise would not KO in one hit or weaken it down for a teammate to revenge kill later.

Choice Scarf: Using a Choice Scarf allows Maushold to surprise faster foes and deal instant damage.

Tera

Maushold is not at the forefront of demand to be a secondary Tera captain. If you choose to make it one anyway, Tera Normal can boost Population Bomb's damage further, whereas Tera Ghost can turn its singular weakness into an immunity, providing it an opportunity to set up or attack, as well as giving it additional coverage to hit Rock and Steel-types more reliably.

Draft Strategy

Maushold should only be drafted on teams that require a Speed tier gap to be filled or if further offensive pressure is required. It's important to note that Maushold can be countered easily with minimal effort, which may dissuade it from coming to matches, but it can serve as a skill check that can overwhelm foes if it receives the right support from teammates.

Defensive Teammates: Maushold appreciates teammates that can sponge hits, since it cannot take hits with its poor defensive stats. Pokemon such as Clefable, Zapdos and Landorus-T are good examples to consider.

Slow Pivots: Maushold appreciates being able to get onto the field safely to gain the opportunity to sweep. Pokemon such as Galarian Slowking, Scizor and Iron Hands can slow pivot to it, preventing it from taking unnecessary hits.

Other Wallbreakers: Pokemon that may not have the best tools to deal with Steel-types but can chip them down low enough are crucial to allow Maushold to sweep without fear of knocking itself out from Rocky Helmet damage. Pokemon such as Rillaboom, Ogerpon-C, and Iron Crown are good examples to consider, especially the former two, as they can remove problematic items with Knock Off.

Checks and Counters

Contact Effects: Well-prepared foes often don a Rocky Helmet in the face of Maushold, which can easily lead it to faint if it attacks with Population Bomb. Maushold can also easily fall victim to Pokemon with contact effects, such as Zapdos with Static, Garchomp with Rough Skin, and Moltres with Flame Body.

Steel-types: Maushold fails to make progress against common Steel-type Pokemon such as Corviknight, Skarmory, and Metagross. These aforementioned foes also commonly don Rocky Helmet, making them easy switch-ins and potentially causing Maushold to KO itself when they doing so.

Physically Defensive Pokemon: Pokemon such as Alomomola, Scream Tail, and Ting-Lu can shrug off Population Bomb at full health, and cripple Maushold in return either through damage or status such as paralysis and burn.

Priority: Maushold is very frail, which means it can be easily picked off by strong priority when it has been weakened enough.
